environment.description: Identical application stack but deployed on EKS with the following pod-level controls: (1) Container runs with a read-only root filesystem (readOnlyRootFilesystem: true in securityContext) with explicit emptyDir volume mounts ONLY at /app/uploads and /app/extracted with medium: Memory and sizeLimit: 100Mi; (2) A Gatekeeper ConstraintTemplate 'K8sAllowedFilesystemPaths' enforces that no volume mount may target paths outside /app/uploads and /app/extracted; (3) The container's seccomp profile (RuntimeDefault) restricts symlink-following syscalls. PgBouncer 1.21 with prepared_statement_mode=server configured for parameterized queries. The emptyDir tmpfs mounts are non-executable (noexec mount option).

config.gatekeeper_constraint: K8sAllowedFilesystemPaths restricts volumeMounts to /app/uploads and /app/extracted only
